text:
Maya Chen: morning team — quick thread for LumenArc preview onboarding. they confirmed seats but compliance + low initial usage are flagged as renewal risks. need an enablement plan.
Samir Patel: can you share which features they're testing and who from their side will attend enablement?
Maya Chen: features: streaming embeddings, rerank API, automated cache. attendees: Taylor (sponsor) + 3 DS + 1 infra (5 total).
Priya Nair: security review outstanding. SSO + audit logs required by their InfoSec. that's the main blocker for pilot adoption.
Jorge Alvarez: engineering requested a short runbook + sample traffic profile. i'll draft a one-pager with QPS, burst patterns, and graceful-fail steps.
Maya Chen: thanks. main asks: (A) Priya schedule SSO call and get IdP metadata, (B) Jorge 1-pager, (C) Samir run the enablement invite. target: clear blockers in 10 business days.
Samir Patel: invite created for enablement — Tue 10am PT. agenda: 1) SSO checklist 2) demo: rerank latency under load 3) failover runbook 4) feedback cadence
Taylor (LumenArc): that time works. we'll DM IdP metadata. audit logs are required for our compliance team before they can approve production use.
onboard-bot: preview-seat-assigned lumenarc-org seats=5 seat_ids=[s-2201,s-2202,s-2203,s-2204,s-2205]
Priya Nair: Taylor please DM SAML metadata and contact for your security reviewer. i'll triage with our infra and give ETA by EOD Friday.
Taylor (LumenArc): DM sent with metadata and contact (samir@lumenarc). also can you enable weekly token usage exports for billing validation?
Maya Chen: noted — product-ops will enable scheduled CSV exports for their org. tagging @product-ops.
Jorge Alvarez: uploaded draft runbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/lumenarc-runbook — includes QPS table, sample curl commands, and a fallback to smaller model variant. request review from @Maya Chen @Priya Nair.
Maya Chen: reviewed. add a short scripted smoke test they can run post-session to verify KV cache and rerank behavior.
Samir Patel: added smoke test to enablement slides. will cover demo and invite DS lead to run the test live.
Priya Nair: audit-log delivery on my radar. will confirm log retention window and format. ETA: Friday COB.
Taylor (LumenArc): appreciate the responsiveness. one more ask: can we have an internal contact for escalation if latency spikes during the trial window?
Maya Chen: assign Jorge as primary eng contact, Samir as CS contact. we'll also create a dedicated Slack thread for live incidents during trial.
Samir Patel: created channel #cs-lumenarc-trial and posted the invite.
Jorge Alvarez: we'll include a short section in the runbook describing rollback steps and how to switch model variants via API keys.
Maya Chen: excellent. i'll mark this account as "high-touch preview" in RevOps and add a renewal-risk flag to track weekly health. set biweekly check-ins until usage is stable.
Samir Patel: follow-up meeting scheduled one week after enablement to review initial telemetry. tagging follow-ups: @Priya Nair, @Jorge Alvarez, @Maya Chen. :thumbsup:
Taylor (LumenArc): thanks everyone — excited to kick the trial off.
Maya Chen: closing notes: capture customer feedback in the feedback form we send post-session; we'll consolidate and send to product. thread paused until after enablement.
